summary: Dispatches season/championship results display messages (ids 478-503) into the shared driver data table: emits a base message-478 entry, then in race-session mode returns early when no best-lap entrant exists, otherwise selects between season standings messages (490-503, chosen by which track database version files are present under the season path via sub_588410) and leader/best-lap messages (479/480/481/397, chosen by scoring-aggregator equality, championship score, and a CRT time comparison), resolves each entrant's display id through NamedEntryLookupInFormatList against the format list dword_5EA5E8 with byte_5EA438 as the null fallback, and finalizes with InsertDriverTableEntry plus PositionChangeDetector.

operations.description: Early guard: proceed only when dword_7D0308 (race active flag) is non-zero and flt_7CF3C8 (track condition state) is non-zero; otherwise the function performs no work.
Initialize the local driver-table entry buffer v91 with sentinel/default values via StructInitWithSentinelValues.
Populate v91 as a driver-data entry with message id 478 and sentinel arguments -1 and -2.0 via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion.
Insert the message-478 entry into the shared driver table target flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry.
Re-initialize v91 with sentinel values before the per-entrant message dispatch.
Find the best-lap entrant in the standings via BestLapEntrantFinder(0, 0), kept in v3; a null result means no best-lap entrant exists.
Fetch the session scoring aggregator via ScoringSessionStatsAggregator(0, 0) into v4.
Dereference the race-standings sort buffer dword_7D2DB0 via LinkedListDereference to obtain the standings list node.
Branch on the standings node's session flags: FlagsGetter(node) equal to 1 selects the race-session path; otherwise the standings/season path is taken.
On the race-session path, return immediately when no best-lap entrant was found (v3 null); this early return bypasses the final driver-table insert and position-change dispatch.

On the standings path, when the dword at node offset 45380 equals 3, enter the season display branch (message ids 490/494/498/502 for a single entrant or 491/495/499/503 for champion and runner-up, selected by the track database version files that exist).

When no best-lap entrant exists in season mode, iterate the standings entries (entry index from ShortComputation_13a0 while the index stays below the ActiveEntityCounter count), skip entries whose dword at offset 412 is zero via FixedOffsetReturn, and track the top two entries v21/v22 using ObjectComparisonWithTiebreak to resolve ties.

Single-entrant season dispatch: test the season path (dword_7D0434, falling back to byte_5EA438) against the track database version filenames aF11999Gdb, aF12000Gdb, aF12001Gdb and aF12002Gdb via sub_588410, and for the matched version emit message 490, 494, 498 or 502 for the best-lap entrant.

Two-entrant season dispatch: apply the same database-version cascade and emit message 491, 495, 499 or 503 for champion v21 together with runner-up v22 when present, else a single message (502, 498, 494 or 490) for v21 alone.

When not in season mode, proceed only if the scoring aggregator is non-null (v4, or retried via ScoringSessionStatsAggregator(0, 1)); then branch on whether the best-lap entrant v3 equals the scoring leader v4.

When v3 equals the scoring leader, compare best-lap timing: read the dword at v3+408 and at BestLapEntrantFinder(name, 1)+408, then compare CRTMathHelper-derived values; the comparison selects message 481, otherwise message 397 with argument 1.
When v3 differs from the scoring leader, gate the champion message on ChampionshipScore(v3): a non-zero championship score emits message 480, a zero score falls through to the default message 479.

Resolve the entrant's display id for the chosen message via NamedEntryLookupInFormatList against the format list dword_5EA5E8, using the entrant name (dword at +0, byte_5EA438 fallback) and team (pointer at +8, byte_5EA438 fallback), then emit the message through DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion.
Finalize on the shared exit path: insert the accumulated entry via InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v91) and dispatch position changes via PositionChangeDetector(0).
Return void; every completed path ends at the shared finalize block or the early race-session return.
